title: Official session import
subtitle: Negotiation sessions read from the official UNFCCC source, for the chosen edition. The source is authoritative: no session is edited here.

noEdition.title: No climate COP
noEdition.description: No edition of the climate COP series exists yet. Create it under events.

forbidden.description: The official session import is reserved for platform-wide administrators. An account attached to a single event cannot access it.

switch.label: Import on
switch.hint: On, the import reads the source and the app shows the sessions. Off, the display is cut at once.

cut.disabled: The import is off: the app shows no official session.
cut.neverRead: The import is on, but no read has succeeded yet: the display stays cut.
cut.unreachable: The source failed to answer too many times in a row: the app shows “Reading unavailable” and links to the official programme.

status.title: Status
status.failingSince: The source has not answered since {moment}.

readNow.hint: One more read, right away. The schedule does not change.
readNow.done: Read requested. The status updates within a few seconds.

settings.title: Settings

archive.label: Archived set
archive.description: A real capture from a past COP, replayed on the chosen dates. For acceptance testing, and until access to the source opens.

live.label: Official source
live.description: The UNFCCC conference calendar, read at the given address.

settings.firstDayHint: The set's first day is moved to this date, local time kept, in the edition's time zone ({zone}). Empty: the original dates.
settings.correctionHint: Added to the source's times: the UNFCCC publishes local time minus one hour.
settings.programmeUrlHint: The link offered to users when the display is cut.
settings.intervalHint: From 60 seconds to one day (86,400). Applies from the next read.
settings.thresholdHint: From 1 to 100. Once reached, the display is cut. Applies from the next read.

journal.title: Read log
journal.caption: The last twenty reads, most recent first
